title: Narrowing Sales Type to Labor or Parts shows only that side
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Make sure the test location's Shop Supplies Charge is 0% and nothing else is invoiced at the test location today.
  • Have a work order for that customer with one labor line of 2.00 hours at $100.00 an hour and one part sold at $50.00, "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts" both set to sales rep A, and invoice it today.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today and the Sales Type column turned on.
custom_steps:
1. Expand sales rep A.
  2. Set the Sales Type filter to Labor only.
  3. Set the Sales Type filter to Parts only.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order's invoice is one row, Sales Type "Labor, Parts".

Step 2:

  • Only the "Labor" side shows.
  • The work order's row reads "Labor" with $200.00 of labor.

Step 3:

  • Only the "Parts" side shows.
  • The work order's row reads "Parts" with $50.00 of parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R12: “With the Sales Type filter narrowed to Labor or to Parts, only that side's row shows (Story 8).”
  • S5-R10: “When one person, or Unassigned, holds both the Labor and the Parts side of a work order and the Sales Type filter includes both, the two show as one row whose Sales Type reads "Labor, Parts" and whose figures are the sum of both sides.”
